assumedBarrel.note: ASSUMED. Not surveyed. See the report.

downstream.label: 10-yr
downstream.boundaryCondition: Normal depth on the surveyed channel slope of 1.20 percent, applied 460 ft below the crossing so the boundary assumption has decayed out of the answer at the road.

upstream.label: 10-yr
upstream.boundaryCondition: Headwater at the Fort Foote Road crossing, inlet control, computed to HDS-5.

outlet.regime: outlet control, H = 6.48 ft, TW set by (dc+D)/2 = 2.95 ft above the outlet invert

notes: The roadway overtops. At the balance point the culvert carries 100.2 cfs and 250.4 cfs passes over the road on 185 ft of crest at EL 54.00.
INLET CONTROL GOVERNS. The entrance is the constriction, so the barrel is not being used to capacity and enlarging the pipe alone will not lower the headwater — the inlet has to be enlarged with it.
